sar.narrative: Between December 28, 2016, and December 30, 2016, suspicious card-not-present activity was identified involving customer C08106 and card C08106-K1, resulting in a total financial exposure of $384.43. The activity consisted of 8 online transactions occurring within a 48-hour window, originating from a device profile marked as new for this account. Specifically, one of the flagged transactions amounted to $128.33, which is 3.7 times this card's historical average of $35.09. Further review indicates that customer C08106 has four prior closed fraud cases on record, specifically CC-0696, CC-3778, CC-1736, and CC-2121. The activity also shows connections to additional cards C02222-K1 and C03095-K2. The affected transaction IDs include T3580804, T3583227, T3583499, T3583503, T3584017, T3585446, T3585726, and T3587858. There is no recorded customer response regarding these transactions.
